_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd truck-simulator/euro-truck-simulator2/egg-euro-truck-simulator2-dedicated-server.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail stops the server with Ctrl+C instead of a kill (^^C), adds an automatic query port instead of the fixed 27016, a lobby name without quotes (it is written into server_config.sii), the euro-truck-simulator-2 tags, the no_console_input flag, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. **Install script fixed**: config files from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned games-steamcmd commit instead of the old parkervcp/eggs master paths, failed downloads fail the install, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 Dedicated Server
author: josdekurk@gmail.com
description: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/bin/linux_x64/eurotrucks2_server" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Euro Truck Simulator 2 dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/

CONFIG_FILE=/mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/server_config.sii
if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
    cd /mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/
    echo "a config file does not yet exist making one!"
    curl -fsSL -o server_config.sii https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/truck-simulator/server_config.sii || exit 1
fi

PACKAGE_FILE=/mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/server_packages.sii
if [ ! -f "$PACKAGE_FILE" ]; then
    cd /mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/
    echo "a server_packages.sii file does not yet exist making one!"
    curl -fsSL -o server_packages.sii https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/truck-simulator/euro-truck-simulator2/ets2-files/server_packages.sii || exit 1
fi

DATA_FILE=/mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/server_packages.dat
if [ ! -f "$DATA_FILE" ]; then
    cd /mnt/server/.local/share/"Euro Truck Simulator 2"/
    echo "a server_packages.dat file does not yet exist making one!"
    curl -fsSL -o server_packages.dat https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/truck-simulator/euro-truck-simulator2/ets2-files/server_packages.dat || exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.description: Auto update the server on startup

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port, written to server_config.sii. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Steam Auth token
variables.description: By default, whenever a dedicated server is launched it is using an anonymous account. For such an account non-persistent server id is generated (used for direct search). To avoid this you can acquire a logon token on https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (game ownership is required)

variables.name: Lobby name
variables.description: The server name in the convoy browser (no double quotes or backslashes).
